tickets.title: Establish complete five-version native catalogs and schema discovery
tickets.deliverable: A maintainer can inspect the complete independently evidenced Console and in-scope Authoring capability set through versioned discovery, with missing wrapper support reported separately from missing native support.

tickets.title: Make branch completion and gap ownership executable
tickets.deliverable: The coverage checker explains exactly which native-supported uses are unavailable or unverified, which implementation ticket owns each gap, and whether the overall effort is actually complete.

tickets.title: Support native metadata conditions for existing-object changes
tickets.deliverable: Valid property and reference changes work across applicable object classes because the Gateway understands their native activation conditions, rather than accepting only previously encountered examples.

tickets.title: Complete conditional configuration of newly created objects
tickets.deliverable: A user can create an object with its requested valid initial fields even when those fields depend on class defaults or prerequisite settings.

tickets.title: Complete plugin creation for Source, owner Effect and ShareSet placements
tickets.deliverable: Users can create every in-scope native-supported plugin placement with the correct parent, class and properties, including supported alternatives on older Wwise versions.

tickets.title: Complete generic object graph and lifecycle operations
tickets.deliverable: Users can create or edit valid object trees and perform copy, move, rename, delete, property and reference workflows without losing permitted target or conflict-mode alternatives.

tickets.title: Complete object queries and metadata discovery projections
tickets.deliverable: Users can express valid in-scope read semantics and inspect every applicable property/reference detail through bounded public queries and metadata discovery.

tickets.title: Complete audio import, reimport and replacement workflows
tickets.deliverable: Users can import, update and replace media and object structures with all in-scope native-supported row and option alternatives through closed import declarations.

tickets.title: Complete SoundBank definition, conversion and build options
tickets.deliverable: Users can manage inclusions, process definitions, convert external sources and generate requested banks without wrapper omissions in valid build branches.

tickets.title: Complete Console project and file-operation alternatives
tickets.deliverable: Users can perform the permitted Console project/file/migration workflows with complete native option handling and accurate terminal outcomes.

tickets.title: Complete SoundEngine control branches and capability lifetimes
tickets.deliverable: Users can perform every in-scope reflected runtime control through meaningful business inputs, with valid game-object and playing-resource lifetimes.

tickets.title: Complete runtime inspection, profiling and transport workflows
tickets.deliverable: Users can inspect and control the permitted profiling/transport sessions and receive complete bounded results with correct resource cleanup.

tickets.title: Complete Topic filtering, event shapes and monitoring outcomes
tickets.deliverable: Users can monitor every in-scope Topic using its legal filtering/options and obtain correctly validated events and truthful completion status.

tickets.title: Expose complete ordinary Authoring layout and view workflows
tickets.deliverable: Users can inspect and manipulate the reflected ordinary Authoring layouts and views through controlled Gateway operations on the correct Wwise host.

tickets.title: Expose Authoring model, window and signal workflows
tickets.deliverable: Users can use native-supported ordinary Authoring model/window/signal capabilities through complete typed business contracts and owned resource lifetimes.

tickets.title: Complete Authoring project, remote and command workflows
tickets.deliverable: Users can use the existing Authoring project/remote/selection/command capabilities with all permitted branches and accurate project/session transitions.

tickets.title: Complete specialized project and object authoring operations
tickets.deliverable: Users can perform the native-specific authoring operations that generic object edits cannot faithfully substitute, with all legal parameters and meaningful target variants.

tickets.title: Complete source-control and compound edit-history workflows
tickets.deliverable: Users can perform supported source-control and compound edit-history operations through complete closed requests with accurate outcomes and authorization.

tickets.title: Complete permitted host-control and remaining fixed Core contracts
tickets.deliverable: Users receive complete permitted host-control/fixed Core inputs and truthful terminal results, including routes whose zero-input shape previously concealed missing outcome handling.

tickets.title: Validate Skill discovery and formal-harness compatibility end to end
tickets.deliverable: An Agent following only the Skill and Gateway discoveries can reach every completed task family without guessing implementation details, and the formal test harness accepts those legal paths.

tickets.title: Complete integrated five-version coverage and scoped acceptance
tickets.deliverable: The integrated Skill is ready for delivery only when every in-scope native-supported business branch is implemented, reachable and proven at its required evidence level.
